# ----------------
## Packages ##
# ----------------

```{r}

library(rbacon)
library(rintcal)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(readr)

```

# --------------------
## Ade-depth models ##
# --------------------

# ------- Baiau Superior --------

```{r}

# Baiau Superior dating file:
BA21_14C <- read.csv("specify your directory/BA21.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

# Baiau Superior depth file:
BA21_depths <- read.table("specify your directory/BA21_depths.txt", header = FALSE)

# --------- Main age-depth model -----------

age_depth_BA21 <- Bacon("BA21", 
                        coredir = "specify your directory",
                        suggest = TRUE, 
                        postbomb = 1, 
                        depths.file = TRUE, 
                        depth.unit = "cm", 
                        age.unit = "yr", 
                        cc = 1
                        )

# --------- Alternative age-depth model -----------

BA_hiatus <- Bacon(
  core = "BA21",
  coredir = "specify your directory",
  sep = ",",
  postbomb = 1,
  depths.file = TRUE,
  depth.unit = "cm",
  age.unit = "yr",
  cc = 1,
  plot.pdf = TRUE,
  seed = 20260928,
  hiatus.depths = 51,
  runname = "_half_point_max_hiatus"
)

```

# ------- Baiau Inferior --------

```{r}

# Baiau Inferior dating file:
BAIN21_14C <- read.csv("specify your directory/BAIN21.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

# Baiau Inferior depth file:
BAIN21_depths <- read.table("specify your directory/BAIN21_depths.txt", header  = FALSE)

# --------- Main age-depth model -----------

age_depth_BAIN21 <- Bacon("BAIN21", 
                          coredir = "specify your directory", 
                          suggest = TRUE,
                          #postbomb = 1, 
                          depths.file = TRUE, 
                          depth.unit = "cm", 
                          age.unit = "yr", 
                          cc = 1,
                          runname = "_v1"
                          )

# --------- Alternative age-depth model -----------

BAIN_hiatus <- Bacon(
  core = "BAIN21",
  coredir = "specify your directory",
  sep = ",",
  postbomb = 1,
  depths.file = TRUE,
  depth.unit = "cm",
  age.unit = "yr",
  cc = 1,
  plot.pdf = TRUE,
  seed = 20260928,
  hiatus.depths = 18.8,
  runname = "_half_point_max_hiatus"
)

```

# --------------------
## Model comparison ##
# --------------------

# ------- Baiau Superior --------

```{r}

# Main age-depth model output for Baiau Superior:
ba_main_model_output <- read.csv("Specify your directory/ba_main_model_output.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";")

# Alternative age-depth model output for Baiau Superior:
ba_hiatus_model_output <- read.csv("Specify your directory/ba_hiatus_model_output.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";")

# Set the hiatus:
hiatus_depth <- 51

# Outputs in long format:
ba_models_long <- bind_rows(
  "Main model" = ba_main_model_output,
  "Hiatus model" = ba_hiatus_model_output,
  .id = "model"
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Keep the hiatus curve disconnected across the boundary:
    section = if_else(
      model == "Hiatus model" & mean.depth > hiatus_depth,
      "Below hiatus",
      "Above hiatus"
    ),
    curve = interaction(model, section)
  ) %>%
  arrange(model, mean.depth)

# Chart:
ba_models_comparison <- ggplot(ba_models_long, aes(x = mean.depth, y = mean.age, 
                                                   colour = model, 
                                                   fill = model, group = curve)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = low.age.CI, ymax = up.age.CI),
    alpha = 0.15,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = hiatus_depth,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Main model" = "#2166AC",
               "Hiatus model" = "#B2182B")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Main model" = "#2166AC",
               "Hiatus model" = "#B2182B")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Baiau Superior",
    x = "Depth (cm)",
    y = "Age (cal yr BP)",
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.position = "right")

ba_models_comparison


```

# ------- Baiau Superior & Baiau Inferior --------

```{r}

# Set the age limits:
age_limits <- range(
  ba_main_model_output$low.age.CI,
  ba_main_model_output$up.age.CI,
  ba_hiatus_model_output$low.age.CI,
  ba_hiatus_model_output$up.age.CI,
  bain_main_model_output$low.age.CI,
  bain_main_model_output$up.age.CI,
  bain_hiatus_model_output$low.age.CI,
  bain_hiatus_model_output$up.age.CI,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ba_models_comparison <- ba_models_comparison +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = age_limits)

bain_models_comparison <- bain_models_comparison +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = age_limits)

# Combine both charts:
baiau_models_comparison <- (
  (ba_models_comparison | bain_models_comparison) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect")
) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

baiau_models_comparison

```
